scope: Current public provider/model coverage expansion; exact official billing sources only. Native records remain comparison-ineligible. No historical imports, release dates, FX or credit conversion are inferred.

new_source_groups.name: Cohere
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public model directory and pricing page. Exact API IDs, deprecated entries and research models stay distinct. Pricing-card names do not bind a versioned API quote; Model Vault instance prices and search units are not token rates.

new_source_groups.name: AI21
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public Jamba directory and direct pricing page. Generic Mini/Large labels do not establish the billing scope of a versioned Jamba endpoint. Cloud-host prices and free-trial credits stay separate.

new_source_groups.name: Perplexity API
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public Agent, Orchestrator, search, embedding and decision billing. Orchestrator is private preview; its public documentation does not establish general access. Tool/request/session fees, tiers and token quotes stay separate.

new_source_groups.name: Cerebras
new_source_groups.scope_note: Complete unauthenticated Shared Inference model feed and selected model references. Free and paid limits can differ; conflicting feed/document limits remain explicit. Dedicated inference is a separate product.

new_source_groups.name: Castform
new_source_groups.scope_note: Complete public pricing response, retaining inference and training as different billing products. Advertised model identifiers establish this billing source only; upstream-provider pricing, limits and cache fees are not inferred.

new_source_groups.name: Arcee AI
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public Arcee Platform rates. Exact served IDs are independent billing offers; creator names do not imply direct upstream-provider billing.

new_source_groups.name: StepFun
new_source_groups.scope_note: Global English pricing document, including text, image, audio and voice charges. Chinese-region billing, coding subscriptions and credits are separate products. Cache hit/miss and session rounding remain explicit.

new_source_groups.name: Upstage
new_source_groups.scope_note: Direct API pricing and model references. Current Solar 4 versions, ended Solar 2/3 service, document pages, prepaid bonuses, VAT and Studio subscriptions stay distinct. No retrospective prices are imported.

new_source_groups.name: Telnyx Inference
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public inference pricing document. Different deployment/pricing sections, promotional rows and cached-input rates are source-native; no cheapest-row selection or inferred endpoint IDs.

new_source_groups.name: TypeSafe
new_source_groups.scope_note: Jev typed-decision models; source-native input-token billing with explicitly free outputs and separate per-request/per-question limits. No assumed equivalence to general chat generation.

new_source_groups.name: Black Forest Labs
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public FLUX image pricing by model, resolution, image/token component and edit/generation scope. Credit, token and image formulas are not converted to text-generation quotes.

new_source_groups.name: Runway
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public developer-API model prices and credit billing, including hosted third-party models. Native seconds, images, characters and credits remain separate; consumer subscription allowances are not API rates.

new_source_groups.name: Stability AI
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public API image, audio, 3D and editing credit tariffs. Native credit amounts and published conversion prose remain evidence, without inferred token rates or reviewed money conversion.

new_source_groups.name: Ideogram
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public API model/capability documentation and linked API billing information. Image resolution, rendering modes and consumer-plan credits do not establish text-token prices.

new_source_groups.name: ElevenLabs
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public API plan and billing documents, including audio, speech, music and other exposed products. Plan allowances, minimum purchases, character/token/second units and concurrency remain native; no flat universal rate is inferred.

new_source_groups.name: BytePlus ModelArk
new_source_groups.scope_note: International ModelArk tariff document. Exact dated IDs, prompt bands, Standard/Flex tiers, peak/off-peak schedules, cache-storage hours and audio/image/video/3D charges remain native. ByteDance is a creator; Chinese Volcano Engine billing is separate.

new_source_groups.name: Adobe Firefly API
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public developer API guide, a bounded product/model-document scope. Monetary API tariffs and consumer subscription-credit equivalence remain unverified; the guide is not an authoritative complete model catalog.

new_source_groups.name: Baidu Qianfan
new_source_groups.scope_note: Public Qianfan product/model overview only. Tariff, currency and endpoint availability remain unverified. No Chinese-to-international billing equivalence, token prices or full-catalog completeness is inferred.

integrity.native_publication: Existing read-only field allowlist and bounded chunks; no warehouse/raw archive publication.

limitations: Native source/model/row/route/product counts are not unique-model or comparable-price counts.
Thirteen added groups remain native-only; Adobe and Baidu have explicitly limited unpriced product/document scopes.
Unresolved served versions, absent current billing witnesses, unsupported conditions and creator-only labels do not establish a current quote or retirement.
Cerebras feed and paid model-reference limits differ; capacities remain unverified in the selected quotes.
Sonar Agent API billing is distinct from legacy search and Orchestrator private-preview billing.
Weight access is unverified for the added identities, without changing older classifications.
Together stays paused, historical scope stays at the original 26 groups, and no code release/gate change is authorized.
